build_biknn_radius_graph: build a biknn radius graph from an AtomicData object with configurable cutoff and soft KNN parameters
build_batched_radius_graph: build radius graphs for a batch of atomic systems with position, cell, and image ID lists
build_single_radius_graph: build a biknn radius graph for a single system given positions, cell, image IDs, and cutoff
build_chunked_radius_graph: build a memory-efficient chunked radius graph for large systems by processing source atoms in chunks
compute_segment_argsort: compute the argsort of values within each segment using a vectorized cumsum-based approach
